newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada July budget deficit narrows on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada July budget deficit narrows on year.

text.p: Canada's budget deficit narrowed to C$1.16 billion in July from C$1.67 billion a year ago, the Finance Department said on Tuesday.
The department said the year-over-year improvement for the month was mostly due to higher revenues. Budgetary revenues rose by C$0.5 billion or 5.2 percent in July.

Over the first four months of the fiscal year, April to July, the deficit has shrunk to C$6.45 billion from C$10.63 billion. Program spending and public debt charges were little changed from a year earlier.
